title: Boundary-strong helix-box Birkhoff sections with prescribed primitive transverse classes for torus-invariant flows
source_title: Periodic orbits and Birkhoff sections of stable Hamiltonian structures
author: Robert Cardona; Ana Rechtman
difficulty_reason: The distinct primitive boundary homology classes require a controlled multiple cover of the interior binding, which an ordinary transverse annulus cannot provide. The authors construct and glue an explicit helicoidal quotient surface, prove its transversality by a derivative calculation and handle both signs of the binding coefficient. They then remove tangencies on the normal blow-up to obtain the required boundary-strong section, supplying the nonroutine geometric construction beyond standard surface topology.
